entities.name: St Patrick & Christianisation

entities.summary: St Patrick's mission (c. 432) brought Christianity to Ireland, integrating with rather than replacing native culture. Early monastic foundations at Armagh, the spread of the Patrician legend, and the unique insular Christianity that emerged.
